title: Interphase hand-off: recorder-comets-and-fixes spec handed off after three reviews
context: Phase 9 ran three spec reviews. The first found 11 issues: the backfill would re-download trimmed media, the Windows cancel failure stood in for 'old copy may remain', a retried save was not covered, decoder answers past 36,000 had no class, a version 2 database had no class, the shell test fake would throw, the restart splash test name did not match, stale recorder test lines remained, and two rows were unclear. The second review found one remaining task gap: the breathing live region value checks. The third approved with no issues. The Phase 10 guard reported only the probe worktree this run had added at cd7e3b1b, which held three untracked copies identical to the spec's draft tests.
options: Hand off the spec as reviewed after removing this run's own probe worktree and re-verifying the guard
Stop the pipeline on the guard difference and wait for the owner
Run another review round before handing off
option_reasons: The guard difference was this run's own worktree, at a commit already on origin, holding only copies of files kept in docs/specs. The owner's standing rule for autonomous runs is to stop only for a change that is not on origin or that touches files a Step writes. After removal the guard verified clean.
The owner said they are unavailable and expect PRs at the end; stopping on a difference this run caused and fully reverted would waste the run.
The last review approved with no issues and nothing changed since, so another round could not make progress.
outcome: Handed off. Record status handed-off, check_record --complete clean, guard verified clean after removing the probe worktree. 15 Steps in 7 MSPs, 38 criteria, 3 unproven (16.20 device frame rate, 16.28 native decoders, 16.33 Windows abort proof), 30 assumptions, no open questions or open_issues. Spec docs/specs/recorder-comets-and-fixes.md, items docs/specs/recorder-comets-and-fixes.items.json.
